h: פָּרָשַׁת אַחֲרֵי מוֹת, ז׳ Acharei Mos, 7
The Divine Dwelling Grows Toward Joy That Endures Forever

p: אִישׁ אִישׁ מִבֵּית יִשְׂרָאֵל וְגוֹ׳ (וַיִּקְרָא יז, ג)
"Any man of the house of Yisrael," etc. (Vayikra 17:3).
In the Midrash (Tanchuma on this parshah, 10):
To a great and powerful rich man
his house is not a house, etc.
and said to them: From now on,
take it up to the house.
אָמַר לוֹ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְמֹשֶׁה
the Holy One, blessed be He, said to Moshe:
except in the Ohel Moed," etc.
for that would resemble the lesson,
that it says in Midrash Tanchuma earlier
and not at my daughter's celebration.
and not at the celebration of the Torah;
'On the day of His wedding' (Shir HaShirim 3:11):
the day of the giving of the Torah;
'and on the day of the joy of His heart':
he calls the giving of the Torah
"the day of His wedding: this is Sinai";
implying that the giving of the Torah
of the Holy One, blessed be He;
so why did he call it "my daughter's celebration"?
it expounds "the day of His wedding":
"this is the giving of the Torah,"
when the second Tablets were given
"the day of the joy of His heart":
"this is the building of the Beis HaMikdash,
may it be built speedily in our days."
which expounds "the day of His wedding" as Sinai,
and it is called "my daughter's celebration,"
for the Torah is the bride of Yisrael,
bestow upon the words of Torah.
וְהוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ
This is along the lines of what they said in the Midrash
the Holy One, blessed be He, said to them:
זָכוֹר אֶת יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת לְקַדְּשׁוֹ כוּ׳
'Remember the day of Shabbos to sanctify it,'" etc.
means that they bestow upon Shabbos;
that is, at the first Commandments,
as before the corruption of the serpent,
and Yisrael were then a chariot
which is the attribute of Malchus.
And Yisrael are called the groom
for all six hundred thirteen mitzvos
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ב פב, ב)
that is, six hundred thirteen kinds of counsel
to merit that there shine in the heart
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ג רנו, ב
"'I am' is from the side of Kesser," etc.).
And this is what they then said,
"We will do and we will hear":
along the lines of what we said
what Hashem will command for you":
so as not to offer," etc.,
"I will hear what He will command," etc.
וּכְעֵין מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּגְּמָרָא (סַנְהֶדְרִין צט, ב)
And similar to what they said in the Gemara (Sanhedrin 99b):
And similarly the holy Zohar expounded
it is written 'and you shall make yourselves,' etc.;
And so it is in the holy Zohar (there, 113b):
as it were, you will make them."
And this is what they said (Shabbos 88a):
to hear the voice of His word' (Tehillim 103:20):
a chariot for the upper Shechinah;
that had they been lacking one,
they would not have received the Torah;
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב (זוֹהַר חֵלֶק א רז, א)
along the lines of what is written (Zohar I 207a)
of Yaakov Avinu, peace be upon him:
into the World to Come," etc.
And then it is called, at the root,
which is the bride of Yisrael;
for Yisrael bestow upon the words of Torah,
the six hundred thirteen kinds of counsel.
And at the root Yisrael are called Imma,
as in the future, the World to Come,
and it is called the wedding day
שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא עִם יִשְׂרָאֵל
of the Holy One, blessed be He, with Yisrael,
and the celebration is "my daughter's celebration,"
which is the Torah, the vav,
and Yisrael who bestow upon the words of Torah:
And this is what the Midrash said,
"the day of His wedding: this is Sinai."
and expounds "the day of His wedding":
"this is the giving of the Torah";
of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah,
and Knesses Yisrael is the bride,
the moon that receives from the sun,
which receives from the Written Torah.
And "on the day of the joy of His heart"
it expounds here: "this is the Ohel Moed."
וְהוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּגְּמָרָא
This is along the lines of what they said in the Gemara
"The joy of the heart is a wife";
the union of Hashem Yisbarach with Yisrael.
"this is the building of the Beis HaMikdash,
may it be built speedily in our days";
and then the rectification was not
(מִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה כ, ב)
(Midrash Rabbah on this parshah, Vayikra Rabbah 20:2):
they are destined to rejoice in the future.
And likewise 'Hashem rejoiced in His works'
the Holy One, blessed be He, is destined to rejoice
in the deeds of the righteous."
אַךְ עֲתִידִין הֵם לִשְׂמוֹחַ לֶעָתִיד לָבוֹא
but they are destined to rejoice in the future,
"May the glory of Hashem be forever;
And this is what it said,
"this is the building of the Beis HaMikdash,
may it be built speedily in our days";
that it refers to the future building,
which will be built in the month of Av,
and the dedication will be completed
and then will be the union,
"the day of the joy of His heart,"
"the joy of the heart is a wife,"
which expounds "the joy of His heart"
it explains that the celebration is not complete:

p: (the Tikkunim at the end of the book, end of Tikkun 6):
and on the day of the joy of His heart':
'the joy of His heart' is the lower Shechinah," etc.
It seems that the Tikkunei Zohar expounds
"the day of His wedding: this is Sinai,"
the day of the giving of the Torah,
and not as it is expounded
in the Mishnah in Taanis cited above.
for then it was like the World to Come:
"I said, you are godly beings," etc.,
that they would not have died
And "the joy of His heart" refers to the Ohel Moed,
"the joy of the heart is a wife,"
אַךְ הַיִּחוּד הוּא רַק לְפִי שָׁעָה
but the union is only temporary
which is not so with "His wedding,"
which is named for the marriage bond,
"It is because of drawing close in mind,
and his mind has drawn close";
is greater than "the joy of His heart";
which is not so according to the Mishnah's exposition,
"the day of His wedding" as Yom Kippur,
when the second Tablets were given,
and there was for its time
it expounds as the future building,
and then the union will be forever:
Hashem will be One and His Name One";
and "the day of the joy of His heart"
is greater than "the day of His wedding."

p: And the opening of Midrash Tanchuma:
this is what the verse says (Tehillim 51:20),
'Do good in Your favor to Tziyon;
To a great rich man, etc.,
why does it bring this verse from Tehillim,
"any man of the house of Yisrael,"
that they bring the offerings to the Ohel Moed?
and "the place that Hashem will choose"
and this is what it says,
He desired it as His dwelling":
And this is why it prefaced the opening,
'Do good in Your favor to Tziyon'":
וְכֵן כָּתַב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קח, א)
and so wrote the holy Zohar (II 108a).
"And I will be for her," etc.,
"fire" is the holiness of the Avos,
for all the Avos are called fire
the shin is the secret of the three Avos,
and the "bas" is crowned with them
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ב רד, א)
which consumes the fire of the yetzer hara
as they said (the Midrash Rabbah cited):
and likewise 'Hashem will rejoice in His works':
עָתִיד הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לִשְׂמוֹחַ כוּ׳
the Holy One, blessed be He, is destined to rejoice," etc.
And Shabbos is a semblance of the World to Come
"'And on the day of your rejoicing' (Bamidbar 10:10):
And when one merits the upper Shabbos,
"Fortunate is he who makes for them
in the two chambers of the heart,
and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there," etc.;
on Shabbos is the spreading of the shelter of peace,
and one merits the holiness of Yerushalayim,
which is the shelter of peace.
שֶׁלֹּא יִהְיֶה שׁוֹמֵר שַׁבָּת חַס וְשָׁלוֹם
so that one not keep Shabbos, Heaven forbid
(as they said in Shocher Tov, Tehillim 92):
he went back and looked, etc.,
to find a flaw in it,
and saw that a person sins on it
and becomes liable with his life;
he said, This too is vanity."
That is, since it is written,
the yetzer hara can, Heaven forbid,
but when one merits the upper Shabbos,
"and the yetzer hara is cleared out from there,"
"the day of the joy of His heart," as was said.

p: "The Holy One, blessed be He, foresaw
that the Beis HaMikdash would be destroyed, etc.:
through what will atonement be made for you?
Occupy yourselves with words of Torah,
which are likened to offerings, etc.,
And since the words of Torah
in which to offer the offerings;
then they themselves will be a Mishkan and Mikdash;
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ג קכד, ב
and on Shabbos and Yom Tov
the shelter of peace is spread
over us and over all His people Yisrael,
so that they are as if dwelling in the Mikdash.
are likened to words of Torah:
words of Torah are likened to wine,
'and drink of the wine I have mixed.'
They offer bread upon the altar,
words of Torah are likened to bread:
They offer oil upon the altar;
words of Torah are likened to oil:
וְשֶׁמֶן עַל רֹאשְׁךָ אַל יֶחְסָר (קֹהֶלֶת ט, ח)
'and let oil not be lacking on your head'" (Koheles 9:8).
דְּבַר ה׳ זוֹ הֲלָכָה (שַׁבָּת קלח, ב)
"the word of Hashem: this is halachah" (Shabbos 138b);
שַׁבָּת דִּבּוּר אִיקְרֵי (זוֹהַר חֵלֶק א לב, א)
And this is why it brought that it is likened to wine,
in the heart of the Sages.
And it is likened to bread,
written in the parshah of the Tamid,
"that they had not eaten the meat of the ox,"
"I did not examine the reason of the matter";
"here is the table and here is the meat,"
"While you were gnawing bones at Abaye's,
And so words of Torah are likened to oil,
denotes the crown that is on the head;
and this is the dew of Torah she'b'al peh,
which is the dew of Atika,
the Holy One, blessed be He,
from the Gemara and Tikkunei Zohar).
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זוֹהַר חֵלֶק א מז, ב)
and for the heart to be a Mishkan for the Shechinah.
